products.product_name: Commix Down Filled Overstuffed Boucle Fabric Corner Chair by Modway

products.product_name: Gridiron Medium Stainless Steel Bench by Modway
products.product_description: Straight lines were once deemed the realm of strict logic. This conduit design accomplishes something quite profound. It blends linear components with a pleasantly stainless steel tubular effect. Modernism used to be about extremes. Wild shapes and patterns that don’t dare resemble its predecessors. We’ve reached an age of maturity of sorts. We appreciate style, but all the more, we respect those designs that represent a blending of cultures. The Gridiron tubular stainless steel bench is famous not for its radical shape, but for the strategic transcendence that it provides. Gridiron is perfect for reception rooms, living and lounge areas, and any other place in need of transformation.

products.product_description: Experience the perfect blend of functionality and elegance with the Culinary Kitchen Cart. Crafted with particleboard and adorned with a beautiful paper laminate, this kitchen island cart brings a natural aesthetic to your home or apartment. Equipped with four nylon casters with side lock brakes, this rolling cart glides effortlessly wherever you need it. Set up a coffee nook or organize your kitchen essentials using its two full-glide drawers, two open shelves, and two storage shelves tucked neatly behind an elegantly hinged glass-front door. From small appliances to pots, pans, and cooking utensils, this kitchen cart with wheels provides ample storage space to keep your kitchen neat and tidy and even includes a convenient towel bar on its side. The Culinary Coffee Bar Cabinet is a versatile small kitchen island that complements modern kitchen furniture and decor. Assembly required.
